description: This file defines an Android activity class 'ImmersiveStickyActivity' that manages immersive mode features by configuring system UI visibility flags when the window focus changes.

classes.name: ImmersiveStickyActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that applies immersive sticky mode to the system UI to hide navigation and status bars.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and obtains the decor view.

methods.name: onWindowFocusChanged
methods.description: Updates system UI visibility flags when the window gains focus to enable immersive sticky mode.
